headline: EPS falls sharply both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Ørsted reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of DKK 1.15, down 28.2% q/q from DKK 1.60 and down 71.7% y/y from DKK 4.06.
summary_long: EPS of DKK 1.15 fell 28.2% sequentially from DKK 1.60 and 71.7% year-over-year from DKK 4.06. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
